document_title: NASA TPSX → Xtrium Dataset Delivery Summary

dataset_statistics.output_format: One JSON file per material record

material_type_breakdown.note: 338 materials have Category values not in the SOP §5.2 mapping table. material_type set to null per SOP. Original Category value preserved in processing_notes.

condition_distribution.note: Condition mapped from _STP column per SOP §6.2 complete mapping table. 'interpolated(T)' STP value could not be mapped — condition set to null, flagged in _stp_review_for_project_lead.json

sop_compliance.rule_1_no_data_loss: PASS — All 1,287 CSV columns accounted for in output JSON
sop_compliance.rule_2_no_schema_modification: PASS — All 25 top-level keys present in every file, no extra keys
sop_compliance.rule_3_property_grouping: PASS — All _Value/_Units/_Uncertainty/_Source/_STP/_Reference/_Last_Modified grouped in single property object raw dict
sop_compliance.rule_4_multiple_instances: PASS — Instance labels applied based on actual row data count (§6.5), not schema column count
sop_compliance.rule_5_null_values: PASS — null for missing scalars, [] for empty lists, no null keys inside any raw dict

field_mapping_compliance.value_format: Exact CSV string. Scientific notation converted to plain decimal (e.g. 6.08e-08 → 0.0000000608). Integers as integers ('288'). Decimals exact ('0.0899').
field_mapping_compliance.numeric_value: Parsed Python float of value string. null if value is non-numeric.
field_mapping_compliance.uncertainty_format: Same rule as value — plain decimal, no scientific notation.
field_mapping_compliance.last_modified: Date only (YYYY-MM-DD). Stripped of '00:00:00' and '| Description:' artefacts.
field_mapping_compliance.stp_field: Preserved as exact CSV text ('True', 'nonstp', 'assumed/assumed', etc). Not floated to 1.0.
field_mapping_compliance.reference_field: Citation index as exact CSV text ('1', '2', etc). Not floated to '1.0'.
field_mapping_compliance.sources_0_source_name: Always 'NASA TPSX Materials Database' (long form) per SOP §8.1
field_mapping_compliance.property_source_name: Short form 'NASA TPSX' or named standard code (ASTM/ISO/NASA-TM) if _Source column contains one, per SOP §6.1
field_mapping_compliance.processing_notes: Assembled from Composition, Description, Notes, TRL, Manufacturer, Original Category, Pictures (non-URL text). Segments joined with double newline. Suppressed artefacts excluded.
field_mapping_compliance.canonical_name: Lowercase-hyphenated material name (no uppercase, no spaces, no special chars)

known_flags_for_project_lead.description: STP value 'interpolated(T)' is not defined in SOP §6.2 mapping table. condition set to null. Raw STP value preserved in raw.STP. Awaiting Project Lead guidance on correct condition mapping.

Category strings not in the 8-entry SOP §5.2 mapping table. material_type set to null per SOP rule. Best-effort mapping applied where possible (e.g. 'Polyamides' → 'polymer'). Original Category value recorded in processing_notes for every affected material.

included_files.xtrium_material_schema_v1.3.json: JSON Schema Draft-07 file used to validate all output files

data_integrity_notes: All 1,287 CSV columns are represented in outputs — no data discarded (Rule 1).
material_id is null in all files — assigned by load_to_neo4j.py at import time (SOP §5.1).
supplier_product_id is null in all files — not present in NASA TPSX data (SOP §5.3).
compliance_references, applications_mentioned, hazard_flags are [] in all files — not in NASA TPSX data.
images are [] in all files — NASA TPSX Pictures column contains descriptive text labels, not URLs.
Property_References full text preserved in sources[0].raw.Property_References per SOP §8.2.
Duplicate canonical names resolved by appending _2, _3 suffix to filename.
